title: Me and Li
simplified_paragraphs: 我和小李是好朋友，我们经常见面。有时候我们一起吃饭，有时候一起去商店买东西，有时候小李帮助我学习汉语，有时候我帮助她学习英语。这个周日，我们准备一起运动。我喜欢打羽毛球，她喜欢游泳。我们想先打羽毛球，再去游泳，两个人都会很高兴。
traditional_paragraphs: 我和小李是好朋友，我們經常見面。有時候我們一起吃飯，有時候一起去商店買東西，有時候小李幫助我學習漢語，有時候我幫助她學習英語。這個週日，我們準備一起運動。我喜歡打羽毛球，她喜歡游泳。我們想先打羽毛球，再去游泳，兩個人都會很高興。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ hé xiǎo lǐ shì hǎo péng you， wǒ men jīng cháng jiàn miàn。 yǒu shí hou wǒ men yī qǐ chī fàn， yǒu shí hou yī qǐ qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xi， yǒu shí hou xiǎo lǐ bāng zhù wǒ xué xí Hàn yǔ， yǒu shí hou wǒ bāng zhù tā xué xí Yīng yǔ。 zhè gè Zhōu rì， wǒ men zhǔn bèi yī qǐ yùn dòng。 wǒ xǐ huan dǎ yǔ máo qiú， tā xǐ huan yóu yǒng。 wǒ men xiǎng xiān dǎ yǔ máo qiú， zài qù yóu yǒng， liǎng gè rén dōu huì hěn gāo xìng。
english_paragraphs: Xiao Li and I are good friends and we meet often. Sometimes we eat together, sometimes we go to the store to buy things together, sometimes Xiao Li helps me learn Chinese, and sometimes I help her learn English. This Sunday, we are going to exercise together. I like playing badminton and she likes swimming. We want to play badminton first and then go swimming. Both of us will be happy.
english_full: Xiao Li and I are good friends and we meet often. Sometimes we eat together, sometimes we go to the store to buy things together, sometimes Xiao Li helps me learn Chinese, and sometimes I help her learn English. This Sunday, we are going to exercise together. I like playing badminton and she likes swimming. We want to play badminton first and then go swimming. Both of us will be happy.
